# gpcn_resource_groups (Data Source)

Lists the resource groups the API key can see, and reports the tenant's Default resource group.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Example: Listing GPCN resource groups
#
# This example lists the resource groups the API key can see and reads the
# tenant's Default resource group, which new resources join when they name no
# other group.

terraform {
  required_providers {
    gpcn = {
      source  = "Global-Private-Cloud-Network/gpcn"
      version = "~>1.4.0"
    }
  }
}

provider "gpcn" {}

data "gpcn_resource_groups" "all" {}

# Look up one group by its exact name
data "gpcn_resource_groups" "team" {
  name = "platform-team"
}

output "default_resource_group_id" {
  description = "ID of the tenant's Default resource group"
  value       = data.gpcn_resource_groups.all.default_resource_group_id
}

output "team_resource_group_id" {
  description = "ID of the platform-team resource group"
  value       = data.gpcn_resource_groups.team.resource_groups[0].id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the resource group with exactly this name. The data source fails when none matches.

### Read-Only

- `default_resource_group_id` (String) ID of the tenant's Default resource group. The name filter does not affect it. Null when the API key sees no Default group.
- `resource_groups` (Attributes List) Resource groups that match the filter. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--resource_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--resource_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `resource_groups`

Read-Only:

- `description` (String) Description of the resource group. Null when it has none.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the resource group.
- `is_default` (Boolean) Whether this is the tenant's Default resource group.
- `name` (String) Name of the resource group.
